scenes.say: Nearly two kilometres flat out. On a straight that long, the new Formula One cars run out of battery.
Since this year the power is split roughly half and half between engine and electrics.
The battery charges under braking. Vegas has few slow corners and a lot of long straights.
So at the end of the straight the car recharges while still flat out. That's super clipping, and top speed drops.
Then there's the cold. Pirelli brings its three softest compounds just so the tyres warm up.
Fifty laps of six kilometres. Whoever manages energy best will be the one passing on the Strip.
Follow speeds and gaps during the race on LapRadar.

title: Vegas 2026: why the Strip is too long for the battery
